body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> SanDisk expects to launch its new 4GB USB flash drive 'Cruzer Titanium Plus' at upcoming CES 2008 in Las Vegas, USA. It supports automatic online back-up feature. It will be available in the USA market starting from March at 59.99 USD. Online backup service will be offered for free for the first six months and it will be charged 29.99 a month afterward.
